resources.string: Complete eligible AI requests in this app with usage included in your ChatGPT plan or credits balance. Works with ChatGPT Plus and Pro. Mika itself is free; nothing is charged by Mika.
Finish signing in in your browser, then come back to Mika.

Use your xAI / Grok subscription for requests in Mika. Requests go straight to the xAI Responses API and are not translated into another protocol. This sign-in reuses the public client identity of the official Grok CLI, not an app registered by Mika. xAI may not support this, and the account can be restricted. Tokens stay encrypted on this phone and are never written to logs.

Use your GitHub Copilot subscription for requests in Mika. Requests go straight to the Copilot Chat Completions API and are not translated into another protocol. This sign-in reuses the public client identity of the GitHub Copilot extension in VS Code, not an app registered by Mika, and sends the editor integration headers that API expects. GitHub may not support this, and the account can be restricted. Tokens stay encrypted on this phone and are never written to logs.

Anthropic does not allow third-party apps to sign in with Claude.ai or to spend subscription usage on their own requests. Google does not allow third-party apps to reuse Gemini CLI sign-in against its backend. Use an API key for those two (the Anthropic and Gemini presets).
